name_en: Dango-jiru — hand-stretched wheat noodles simmered in miso soup
summary_ja: 小麦粉をこねて薄い帯状に伸ばした「だんご」を、根菜やしいたけと共に麦味噌仕立ての汁で煮込む大分の日常食。米づくりに適さない台地が多く粉食文化が根づいた大分ならではの一椀で、うどんより強いコシが持ち味。
summary_en: Wheat dough kneaded and stretched into flat ribbons is simmered with root vegetables and shiitake in a barley-miso broth — an everyday Oita dish born of the prefecture's flour-based food culture, where poor rice land pushed wheat to the fore; the ribbons keep a firmer bite than udon.
source_title: だんご汁 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Gan-jiru — river crab ground whole and simmered into a savory soup
summary_ja: 生きたモクズガニ（ツガニ）を殻ごとすりつぶし、こして塩や醤油で仕立てる宇佐市の汁物。加熱するとタンパク質がふわふわと固まり、高菜を入れて旨味を集める食べ方が伝わる、川の恵みを丸ごと使う一椀。
summary_en: A live mitten crab is ground shell and all, strained, and simmered into a broth seasoned with salt or soy sauce — a Usa dish in which the protein sets into soft curds as it heats, often gathered with mustard greens added to draw out more flavor.
source_title: がん汁 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Niwatori-jiru — a clear soup made from the whole chicken carcass and offcuts
summary_ja: 鶏がらでとった出汁に、鶏肉やごぼう、しいたけ、長ねぎを加えて仕立てる豊後大野地方の汁物。「鶏めし」をつくる際に余った身や内臓を使うことも多く、鶏めしと対でつくられてきた鶏肉消費量日本有数の大分らしい一椀。
summary_en: Chicken bones simmered into a clear broth are joined by chicken meat, burdock root, shiitake, and leek — a Bungo-Ono soup often made from the offcuts and innards left over when cooking torimeshi, the two dishes long paired in a prefecture known for eating more chicken than almost anywhere else in Japan.
source_title: 鶏汁 大分県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
